issues.title: 500 error on POST /api/cart
issues.description: Cart endpoint throws when payload contains an empty email field — no validation guard.
issues.suggestedFix: Add input validation and a try/catch around the handler for this route — the server is throwing on unexpected input rather than returning a 4xx.

issues.title: Unhandled exception on /checkout
issues.description: price is read from an undefined object when a cart item loses its product reference.
issues.suggestedFix: Guard the access with optional chaining (?.) or a null check before the property is read — the underlying value isn't guaranteed to exist yet.

issues.title: Mobile layout issue on /checkout
issues.description: Overlapping text detected — order summary total collides with the checkout button on small mobile screens.
issues.suggestedFix: Increase spacing/margin between the colliding elements at this breakpoint, or switch to a stacked (flex-column) layout below the tablet breakpoint.
